newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bank IPB to detail 1996 results Wed.
newsitem.headline: Czech bank IPB to detail 1996 results Wed.

text.p: Czech bank IPB a.s. said on Friday it would reveal a detailed auditor's report on its 1996 results next Wednesday.

The bank said it had an 857 million crown audited after-tax 1996 profit last week, according to international accounting standards, significantly lower than the preliminary net profit it announced earlier in the year of 1.51 billion.
It said the latest figure would be confirmed by an unqualified audit. IPB posted a 1.01 billion net profit in 1995. The bank has not revealed any further information on its 1996 performance.
IPB said on Friday that details of the results would be announced at a news conference at still to be announced time next Wednesday.

Czech bond and share markets, ahead of the profit announcement last week, had been rife with rumours that the bank would report massive losses on its 1996 results, which senior officials at the bank quickly dismissed.
In early March, the bank announced it was changing its auditor from Coopers & Lybrand to Ernst and Young for an unspecified reason.
